title: Marty NDE 2463
content: Firstly, I want to enter my experience before reading others to see what is or may be not similar as compared to others. I don't want to be biased by others' stories before entering my own. I have heard about the tunnel vision and a buzzing sound, and a bright light at the end, and the feeling and vision of unearthly beings or spiritual forces. I felt and experienced all of these. When I was a boy of nine or ten I acquired strep throat, but my mom thought I had a flu. During the time, my mom was a nursing student and she thought that she knew better, but my fever reached 104-105 and she rushed me to the hospital in the family station wagon. I recall being weak and lethargic laying down on a hospital gurney. The doctor was just finishing giving me a cold shot of penicillin when my body went into shock with a fever of 105. I heard a buzzing noise that grew in pitch and the room began to spin increasingly in sync with the sound. I felt my body explode out of something and into another realm of calm, peace and beauty. I felt that I was traveling in a tunnel, which I think is a common experience felt by others. At the end of this tunnel, was a very bright light and I was getting closer and closer to the end and I saw brilliant beings of some sort. There was no speaking. But it was understood by a both of us that I would go no further. I heard the most beautiful music that I ever heard and can't describe it. This experience lasted a few seconds. I came back in a reverse manner with the buzzing sound getting lower and lower this time. My eyes opened to see the room spinning slower and slower and back into consciousness. When I came to, I was sitting in an ice bath to bring down my fever. I remember telling my mom what I felt and she told me to be quiet and she did not believe me. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1971 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Strep Life threatening event, but not clinical death Strep Fever of 105 and convulsions. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal More felt like ESP. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? At the light. Were your thoughts speeded up? Incredibly fast Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once Sensed a connection with space. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Brightness. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Buzzing sound. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Yes, and the facts have been checked out Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain Did not pass but saw a glimmer of another side. Did you see any beings in your experience? Sensed their presence Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Saw bright silhouette of beings with on focus with me. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm I now believe that it was another dimension. The tunnel could be a worm hole? The worm hole could be time travel? What emotions did you feel during the experience? Love. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Can't be sure. Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Don't believe in one denomination but of a greater existence of a higher order. What is your religion now? Liberal Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Don't believe in one denomination but of a greater existence of a higher order. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Sensed their presence Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain Maybe universal? Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes It's nice knowing. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes I heard the most beautiful sounding music in my life! Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I think that I can see peoples' hearts? Not mind reading. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Somehow making contact with a being. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Teenager. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain Just ideas from religion. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real Felt like I was not afraid to die after that. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I vividly recall it more than any other memory of my boyhood thirty five years ago! At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I'm now curious to read others' experiences. I have a feeling some things are commonly felt by people worldwide.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Described as feeling his body "explode out of something" into calm/peace/beauty.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He reported feeling he was traveling in a tunnel; later questionnaire comment: "Did not pass but saw a glimmer of another side."

arrival.other_being_detail: Saw "brilliant beings of some sort" / "bright silhouette of beings"; also "sensed their presence."

environment.environment_other_detail: Entered "another realm of calm, peace and beauty"; heard indescribably beautiful music.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Returned "in a reverse manner" with the buzzing lowering and the room spinning slowing until consciousness returned.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Strep throat; penicillin injection reaction/shock with fever 104-105 and convulsions.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: "Moderate" (not specified). After: "Liberal"; less tied to a denomination, belief in a higher order.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Buzzing sound and room spinning; beautiful music; sense of "ESP"/awareness elsewhere.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE-like separation with buzzing/spinning, tunnel toward bright light with beings, boundary/no further, reverse return with buzzing decreasing and regaining consciousness.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prominent buzzing sound with increasing pitch synced with room spinning; return described as a reverse of that process; extraordinarily beautiful music.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I felt my body explode out of something and into another realm of calm, peace and beauty." / "There was no speaking. But it was understood... that I would go no further." / "I heard the most beautiful music that I ever heard and can't describe it."
